sizeGbAllowedRange.description:
The permitted range for the {@link App.NodePool.Config.SharedStorage#sizeGb}
Value of -1 indicates there are no limits.

enabled.description: Allows {@link App.NodePool} to enable shared storage for an env. Note this defaults to false.

sizeGb.description: Size of shared storage for an env.

storageType.description: StorageType for an env, e.g. disk or nfs

title: Configuration options for shared storage for c3 Node {@link App.NodePool}.
name: App.NodePool.Config.SharedStorage
